verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a government e-services portal that collects personal data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use posture is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack contains only HTTP probes of the front door and a dead legacy entry path. Neither says anything about AI training use, an opt-out, or data-use policy, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
